---
name: Request a tool
about: Suggest a new browser-native, local-first tool for the catalogue
title: "[Tool request] "
labels: tool-request
assignees: ''
---

**What should the tool do?**
One or two sentences — what task, for whom.

**Why can't a chatbot do this?**
Per the project's own principle, this catalogue focuses on what AI chat can't do
(media, documents, devices, visual output) — explain the gap.

**Is there a good local-first way to build it?**
If you know of a browser API, WASM library, or on-device model that would make
this work without uploading files to a server, mention it. If you don't know,
that's fine — leave this blank.

**Similar tools you've used elsewhere (optional)**
Links or names of tools that do something similar, and what's missing from them.
